configuration_condition.only_profile_file_change_from_default_n2: candidate source manifest v8 to v9

limitations: Fixture journal may remain active; projection hashes the exact bytes read and reports any incomplete final record.
Native prompts, arguments, credentials, correlation/session/process IDs, raw error text and absolute paths are excluded.
Full native error/retry coverage is not implied by mock requests or successful task artifacts.
Singleton smoke quantiles validate plumbing only; they do not establish concurrency capacity.

semantics.item_denominators: Started repeats come from queue rung_start; dispatched pair/turn slots use planned concurrency. Observed started item functions are a lower bound from retained item/turn records; absent records do not prove they never started. Error categories describe retained item error text, not independently inferred root causes.
semantics.missing_data: Missing requested repeats or undispatched jobs are not converted into backend failures/caps. No inferred real-model throughput.
semantics.post_first_tool_seconds: Existing harness work_seconds, from first tool event to session.stream exhaustion; may include the result-delivery/cleanup tail after the result event; preserved as a separate metric.
semantics.request_completion: Arrival plus server processing_seconds, including response delivery; signed tails may extend beyond hmz result and are retained.
semantics.request_to_result_seconds: Earliest correlated mock request to hmz result; includes mock response delivery, tools, CLI transport and driver completion.
semantics.resources: Per-turn windows contain the whole rung process tree/cgroup; overlapping turns share resource observations.
semantics.selection: Only controller-accepted, fully correct, clean constrained rungs with complete unique turn keys and valid fixture correlation enter distributions. Raw diagnostic turns remain visible.
semantics.startup_seconds: Turn start to earliest correlated mock request, including auxiliary calls.
